metadata.name: File Metadata Manifest for Katharinentalerhof Pforzheim Event
metadata.description: A metadata manifest listing 12 files associated with the Katharinentalerhof_Pforzheim event. The dataset contains file names, formats, sizes, and URLs pointing to a Pangaea repository. All records correspond to a single geographic location (48.92°N, 8.70°E) in Pforzheim, Germany. The temporal data (Date/Time) is entirely missing from this resource.
